name: pirx-radar-backend
description: PIRX iCAS2 ADS-B Radar Backend — Beast → WebSocket → Browser + VHF Audio Streaming

scripts.check:sox: which sox && sox --version || echo 'sox not found — sudo apt install sox'
scripts.check:rtl: which rtl_fm && rtl_fm --help 2>&1 | head -1 || echo 'rtl_fm not found — sudo apt install rtl-sdr'
scripts.check:alsa: which arecord && arecord --version || echo 'arecord not found — sudo apt install alsa-utils'

author: PIRX
